note: Site metadata for each build. Run numbers live in ../results.json; this file says what ships and how to describe it. `ship` is copied verbatim into dist/builds/<dir>/; `source` is what counts as the model's own code (vendored three.js and bundles excluded).

models.solver: MAC-grid shallow water, semi-Lagrangian momentum, Flather offshore boundary
models.notes: Solver runs in a Web Worker and streams snapshots to the renderer. Sediment is carried with the flow and settles where it slows; floating cars and debris can hit buildings.

models.solver: Staggered-grid shallow water, upwind advection, wet/dry fronts, wave maker
models.notes: Plain scripts, no build step; three.js comes from cdnjs. Optional flow arrows and a camera that follows the wave crest.

models.solver: Inertial shallow water on a staggered grid, implicit Manning friction, flux limiting
models.notes: Bundled with esbuild into one script. Damage metrics are compared against the previous run.

models.solver: Virtual-pipes flux scheme with outflow clamping and sponge boundaries
models.notes: The only run that left no README. A stable pipe model rather than a momentum solver: depth can never go negative, whatever the wave.
